name: Diamond Skin
body:
Design alteration; Level 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 10 min./level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

The targeted creature gains resistance to blows, cuts, stabs, and slashes. This functions as a stoneskin spell, except as noted here.

Overload: For each runic charge overloaded into this script, you may target an additional creature. No two targets can be further than 30 feet apart. Once the script has prevented 10 points of damage per caster level (maximum 150 points) for a subject, the script’s effects end for that subject.
